title: Certify a coherent-contact cost ceiling for the retained 640-input interface (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Retaining #4694's eight arbitrary center inputs changes an actual search premise: #4841/#4690 froze every owned-center scalar contact. This package exposes all 184 such contacts while fixing all 640 endpoint charts, every other chart, the native maps and scalar chronology. It retains all 408 independent helper jobs and charges every incident old-field and center transition. The baseline paid profile remains `{1:2201,2:412,3:510,4:127,5:40,8:8}`. Independent center productive reward remains zero.

The coherent-block ceiling is strict: for each of 1,022 one-transvection alternatives to the empty chart, every nonempty subset of its 176 contacts increases the optimistic complete paid moment by at least `2-2^theta>0` for every `0<theta<1`. This includes long and noncontiguous blocks across different centers. The proof uses 9,198 exact integer maxflow/mincut certificates for nine concave-prefix tariffs, with uniquely empty first-prefix minima.

The complete 188,048 single-contact neighbors and 1,834,488 same-transvection adjacent-pair neighbors have exact minimum paid loss `1+7^theta-8^theta>0`. Every actual incident binary rank is recounted. No higher κ, new native supplier, independent center jobs, completed caller admission or selected-frontier change is claimed. The coupled ABI is not substituted into #4610's owned-center caller.

## Task and overlap

Task `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, priority revision 7; scope changed to the retained-centre contact invoice. This is a changed-contract continuation of Cinna Davis's #4694/#4698, Cao Yifan's #4610 and Dugongue's #4841. Permitting nonmonotone general-Lagrangian contacts changes #4696's fixed-subspace phase restriction and #4700's monotone canonical-chart restriction. The old frozen 632-role contact search is not repeated.

Canonical main was refreshed and remains `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`. The #4841 compiler/neighborhood source is pinned at `6debdcdac8fe1c87958f8cd42ccb7db73c0a0eef`. Fresh open-PR and Discussion overlap was inspected; #4694/#4698 remain the relevant coupled-interface sources. The separately assigned shared-producer work owns changed-demand exploration. Live #4859 (`45352b400f986482a5f9cc16ce76292da5f6bcc3`) counts shortest binary chart words, while #4860 (`e36ff5b6431d3014b9ca0a1a49a5274d82788252`) concerns cyclic canonical-checkpoint costs. Nick Petalas's [live coordinated-chart claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19133726) targets general cycle-constrained tuple enumeration and expressly leaves source-specific application open. This package certifies the actual retained-640 cost instance; it makes no novelty claim for the general neighborhood theorem. Only `research/sol1337-contact-frontier/` changes. A tree-preserving provenance merge retains the exact #4841 history without importing its files into the publication tree.

Contribution head: `5e4cce12a9851fbb46cd7c32cc8177e983771539`.

## Validation

On CPython 3.12.3 and GCC 13.3 C++20: metadata/source pins, registered replay, normal and optimized scientific replay, committed-byte/source-history preflight, and official 22-file export integrity and extracted Git-free optimized replay pass. The verifier regenerates the 640-role graph, every candidate class and all 9,198 integer cuts. Flow capacities/conservation, feasible flow values, equal attaining cut capacities and residual strictness are checked. Three controls reject a false paid gain, a negative cut and false uniqueness.

A separate read-only AI audit reports no correctness finding. It reran the full verifier, independently recomputed all 34,830 baseline edge ranks, checked all 145 maps are symplectic, confirmed the 176-contact group and 256 internal rank-zero edges, and directly priced 35 nonempty subsets across seven axes. This is independent AI review, not human or proof-kernel review.

```sh
python3 -I -B research/sol1337-contact-frontier/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/sol1337-contact-frontier/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/sol1337-contact-frontier
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/sol1337-contact-frontier --check-source-history
```

Expected marker: `PASS_RETAINED_CENTER_COHERENT_CHART_CEILING`. Requires `c++`; compiled binaries and graphs stay in temporary directories. Hosted CI is pending publication. No native amplitude/all-width phase compilation, replacement 640-column native word, selected cold replay, Lean or outer theorem was run. This is a source-bound optimistic cost model.

Exact source paths, Git blobs and byte-preserved copies are pinned in `SOURCES.json`.

Prepared for Chris R with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance by a dedicated gpt-6.1-sol HIGH agent in user-authorized parallel research. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

The ceiling permits one identical-chart group to move toward one common one-transvection alternative. Mixed alternatives, simultaneous different original groups, independent paired axes and changed scalar/controller/native operations remain outside its scope. Before another expansion, supply one literal changed operation or actual changed request, its arbitrary-input endpoint and complete producer/consumer bill. A role-dependent monomial router must retain each role's address action and dirty restoration; more chart seeds or root digits do not change this ceiling.


## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated research package, with a tree-preserving provenance merge. No selected record, shared helper or predecessor file changes.


[Canonical investigation #4840](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4840) and the required [handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19133861) record the stopping decision and exact changed-mechanism follow-up.
